dispositions.accepted_fact: 1907-12-16 Washington State at Gonzaga; Gonzaga L 18-21; HOME
basis: Washington State current official record-vs-opponents table: WSU A W 21-18 on Dec. 16, 1907.
Gonzaga official 2015 game notes: FIRST MEETING 1907 - WSU won 21-18 in Spokane.
Later Gonzaga 2025/26 notes reversing the winner are an isolated modern summary defect.

dispositions.accepted_fact: 1915-02-20 Gonzaga at Montana State; Gonzaga W 12-9; AWAY
basis: Montana State 2024-25 official detailed year-by-year results explicitly record MSU L 12-9.
Montana State's 1914-15 season heading is 4-6 in both 2024-25 and 2025-26 editions.
The 2025-26 detailed row alone changes the result to MSU W 12-9 and is treated as a current-edition literal defect.

dispositions.accepted_fact: Do not admit the disputed Montana State 32-7 assertion as a Gonzaga game.
basis: Montana State 2024-25 opponent/year-by-year history assigns 32-7 to Gonzaga.
Montana State 2025-26 year-by-year reassigns 32-7 to at Montana.
Montana's own current year-by-year has no corresponding 32-7 loss to Montana State.
The assertion is therefore unstable/misattributed and insufficient Gonzaga game authority.
